recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; the current source implements the approved issue-family outcome and no follow-up core source edit is needed.

initial_application: Historical commits 6497963440 and 9a331d0ab4 pre-applied FHIR-6111 with FHIR-6100: first changing the old rate/rateAdjustment datatypes, then replacing the separate rateAdjustment element with enteralFormula.administration and administration.rate[x] Quantity|Ratio.

Later resource rename commits changed NutritionOrder to NutritionRequest and then back to NutritionOrder; current source/fhir.ini actively lists nutritionorder=NutritionOrder.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the active StructureDefinition source has enteralFormula.administration 0..*, administration.quantity Quantity, administration.rate[x] Quantity and Ratio, explanatory Ratio-vs-Quantity comments, and no current rateAdjustment element.
